name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-05-19, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
